narrative: The model estimates an 11% chance that you will fail the final year, so failing is unlikely but not impossible; the remedial courses are being required as a precaution rather than because failure is the model’s clear expectation. Ask your family and teachers for feedback early, and review progress regularly so the small risk does not grow.
